value.rationale: An oscillatory inertial filter with two-state bounded forcing can overturn the negative fourth cumulant of its input. The exact phase diagram proves the effect is possible only in a sharply delineated, substantially smaller-than-underdamped domain h<0.08487854, with precisely two flip-rate crossovers and a single cusp. It supplies a mathematically motivated non-Gaussian benchmark that second moments and mode-shape regimes do not decide; it is not a routine parameter substitution or known-table restatement.
